title: AWS Serverless & Automation Projects
subtitle: Six hands-on AWS projects, combined into one portfolio architecture
audience_line: Engineers with AWS architecture basics who want hands-on portfolio projects
overview: This programme is built from projects. Participants deploy a scalable web application with Terraform, ship containers to ECS Fargate through GitHub Actions without long-lived keys, build a serverless API and an event-driven image processing pipeline, automate incident response, and add security gates to a container pipeline. Each project starts from a provided starter repository and ends with a working, torn-down deployment. The programme closes with a final project in which participants combine the projects into one documented portfolio architecture with infrastructure as code and a cost review.

facts.label: Audience
facts.value: Engineers with AWS architecture basics who want hands-on portfolio projects

facts.label: Prerequisites
facts.value: AWS Solutions Architect Associate (course), plus Terraform and GitHub Actions basics (as taught in DevOps Engineering). These are used, not taught

facts.label: Duration
facts.value: 18 h: 15 h of chapters + 3 h buffer

facts.label: Format
facts.value: Project labs from provided starter repositories, each with a short design briefing

facts.label: Lab environment
facts.value: One laptop per participant (Terraform, AWS CLI, Git, Docker); a GitHub repository and an AWS sandbox account per team, provided by the organiser, with a budget alert; every project destroyed with terraform destroy at the end of the lab to control cost

facts.label: Assessment
facts.value: Each project validated when it runs, and a final portfolio project presented to the group; certificate of completion for participants who complete both

facts.label: Outcome
facts.value: Participants leave with six working AWS projects in Git, combined into one documented architecture they can explain, rebuild and cost

phases.name: Containers & Infrastructure as Code
phases.focus: Terraform web stack, CI/CD to ECS Fargate with OIDC
phases.intro: Participants provision a scalable web stack with Terraform from a starter repository, then deliver a containerised version through GitHub Actions to ECS Fargate, authenticating to AWS with OIDC instead of stored keys. Validated projects: the web stack answering behind its load balancer, and a commit that reaches Fargate through the pipeline.

chapters.title: Scalable Web App
chapters.content: Terraform: VPC, Application Load Balancer, Auto Scaling, RDS, from a provided starter repository

chapters.title: CI/CD to ECS Fargate
chapters.content: GitHub Actions with OIDC, Amazon ECR, Amazon ECS on Fargate

phases.name: Serverless & Security Automation
phases.focus: Serverless API, event-driven pipeline, incident automation, image scanning gates
phases.intro: Participants build serverless and event-driven systems: an API on Lambda, API Gateway and DynamoDB, an image processing pipeline triggered by S3 events, automated incident response from GuardDuty and CloudWatch through EventBridge, and a container pipeline that stops on critical vulnerabilities. Validated projects: each of the four running and demonstrated with a test event.

chapters.title: Incident Response Automation
chapters.content: GuardDuty and CloudWatch to EventBridge to Lambda and SNS

chapters.title: Container Security Pipeline
chapters.content: ECR scanning, Amazon Inspector, build gates

phases.name: Final Project
phases.intro: Each participant combines the six projects into one portfolio architecture, documented so that another engineer could rebuild it, and presents it to the group.

chapters.title: Integrate & Document
chapters.content: Combine the projects in one repository with infrastructure as code, architecture diagram and README

chapters.title: Cost Review, Demo & Teardown
chapters.content: Cost review, live demo, full teardown; questions and feedback

project.title: AWS Portfolio Architecture
project.brief: The six projects combined into one documented architecture: a web tier and containers on Fargate, a serverless API and event pipeline, incident automation and image scanning gates, all rebuilt from code and reviewed for cost.
project.stack: AWS: VPC, ALB, Auto Scaling, RDS, ECR, ECS Fargate, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, EventBridge, SNS, GuardDuty, Inspector; Terraform, GitHub Actions
project.deliverable: Git repository with IaC and pipelines, architecture diagram, cost review, live demo
